“How much are you worth?” he demanded of the peon with apparent irrelevance.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u012-r0006", "tag": "p", "text": "But the peon could not understand.", "sha256": "4ce0e06e4e991335206e01052dc11ba2743c43af67881a57c929aa997dce9f04", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[914]", "source_html": "

But the peon could not understand.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u012-r0007", "tag": "p", "text": "“How much are your clothes worth—all you’ve got on?”", "sha256": "6b80bbeaffceadae547a1ea210893a6e6a7bda70b39b4c0898cc25e825b8f990", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[915]", "source_html": "

“Half a peso, nay, half of a half peso,” the peon admitted ruefully, surveying what was left of his tattered rags.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u012-r0009", "tag": "p", "text": "“And other property?”", "sha256": "5b938b6681f27f74c7e1a78401c9e3f8629c262b0d6f1e19a7376c90165f2059", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[917]", "source_html": "

“And other property?”

The wretched creature shrugged his shoulders in token of his utter destitution, then added bitterly:

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u012-r0012", "tag": "p", "text": "“Huh!” Francis could not forbear to grin. “Worth two hundred and fifty pesos less than nothing, not even a cipher, a sheer abstraction of a minus quantity without existence save in the mathematical imagination of man, and yet here you are burning up not less than millions of pesos’ worth of oil.
